results.name: Stream Chunk-Boundary Redactor
results.threat: Secret split across independent stream stdout chunks bypassing single-chunk regex matching
results.input: Chunk 1: "Execution started with key: sk-ant-api03-abc" | Chunk 2: "def1234567890abcdef123456 and continuing."
results.method: Feed split buffer into createStreamSanitizer with sliding boundary buffer
results.expected: Raw token must never appear in stream output; replaced by 'secretRef:anthropic-key'
results.observed: Total output: "Execution started with key: secretRef:anthropic-key and continuing.". Raw secret present: false. secretRef present: true.
results.boundary: Only monitors stdout/stderr piped through 'hetzer exec'. Unmanaged terminal processes are outside this interceptor.

results.name: Strict Scoping Child Environment Whitelist
results.threat: Child process inherits parent environment credentials or master encryption key via process.env
results.input: Parent env containing AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY, UNAPPROVED_TOKEN, HETZER_GRIMOIRE_KEY with '--strict --allow allowed-api-key'
results.method: Resolve environment with strictBaseEnvironment whitelist and scoped reference matching
results.expected: Only explicitly allowed credential resolved; all unwhitelisted parent variables and master key dropped
results.observed: ALLOWED_TOKEN resolved: true. Leaked AWS: false. Leaked unapproved: false. Leaked master key: false.
results.boundary: OS-level essential variables (PATH, SYSTEMROOT, TEMP) are retained to allow process execution.

results.name: 5-Generation Process Ancestry Guard
results.threat: Autonomous agent invoking 'hetzer creds reveal' through nested subprocess layers to steal plaintext
results.input: Agent tree: [cmd.exe -> powershell.exe -> code.exe -> explorer.exe] vs Clean tree: [cmd.exe -> powershell.exe -> bash -> init]
results.method: Inspect ancestor process names up to depth 5 across Windows CimInstance, macOS ps, and Linux /proc
results.expected: Agent ancestors (code, cursor, claude, agy) detected and flagged with isAgent: true; clean trees pass
results.observed: Agent chain flagged: true (code.exe). Clean chain flagged: false.
results.boundary: Safeguard heuristic against automated agent calls. Not a cryptographic OS sandboxing boundary against a malicious binary.

results.name: Git Pre-Commit Leak Prevention & False-Positive Immunity
results.threat: Accidental commit of raw PKCS#8 private keys vs Developer deadlock from false alarms on tool IDs & test fixtures
results.input: Multiline private key PEM block, agent tool call ID ('call_...'), and synthetic test file ('*.test.mjs')
results.method: Staged diff multiline chunk scanner with agent ID prefix filter and test file path exemption
results.expected: Block true private key leak; permit agent tool IDs and test fixture files without error exit 1
results.observed: Real leak detected: true. Agent ID false alarm triggered: false. Test files exempted: true.
results.boundary: Evaluates staged diffs in git. Commits made with 'git commit --no-verify' bypass git hooks by design in Git.

results.name: Interactive Stream Sanitizer Latency
results.threat: 16KB buffering lag causing terminal output freeze and stalling interactive agent executions
results.method: Measure write() processing latency with dynamic 128-byte retention buffer and bounded 512-byte window
results.expected: Write execution completes in sub-5ms without buffering stalls or CPU spikes
results.observed: Execution latency: 0.01 ms. Output delivered: "Compiling module auth.mjs...".
results.boundary: Streams with secrets exceeding 128 chars scale buffer to 2x secret length to ensure boundary integrity.

results.name: Canary Honey-Token Tripwire Protocol
results.threat: Automated agent prompt injection or scraping attempting to resolve decoy honey-tokens
results.input: Resolving or revealing credential with ID 'canary-token'
results.method: Canary pattern detection, incident logging, audit recording, and throwing structured error
results.expected: Throws ERR_CANARY_TRIPWIRE_TRIGGERED with explicit exitCode 43; guarded operation aborted
results.observed: Tripwire triggered: true. Error code: "ERR_CANARY_TRIPWIRE_TRIGGERED". Exit code: 43.
results.boundary: Monitors guarded reference resolution and vault reveal. Arbitrary reads of OS disk outside Hetzer are not monitored.
